description: Chapter 6 - Angular momentum. A book-led sequence for commutation relations, angular-momentum algebra, consequences, matrix representations, position-space operators, generalized uncertainty and exercises.

topics.title: Angular momentum: chapter roadmap
topics.note: The chapter presents the formal algebra of angular momentum, which can be orbital or spin, and prepares the addition of angular momenta in the next chapter.

topics.title: Commutation relations
topics.note: The angular-momentum components obey nonzero commutators, so two components cannot be determined simultaneously with absolute precision.

topics.title: Box 6.1: commutator proof
topics.note: Box 6.1 derives the commutator by combining the Levi-Civita form of angular momentum with the position-momentum commutator.

topics.title: Compatible observables: L squared and Lz
topics.note: Because L squared commutes with each angular-momentum component, the book chooses L squared and Lz as simultaneous observables.

topics.title: Raising and lowering operators
topics.note: The operators L plus and L minus move between eigenvectors of Lz while preserving the eigenvalue of L squared.

topics.title: Ladder action and endpoints
topics.note: The ladder changes b in steps of hbar, while positivity confines b between an upper and lower endpoint.

topics.title: Angular momentum spectrum
topics.note: The book defines l and m from the finite ladder and obtains the eigenvalues of L squared and Lz.

topics.title: Normalized ladder action
topics.note: Corollary 6.9 determines the normalization factor multiplying the neighboring state reached by L plus or L minus.

topics.title: Consequences: transverse components
topics.note: Once Lz has a definite value, the transverse means vanish but their variances do not.

topics.title: Matrix representation
topics.note: Section 6.4 writes Lz, L squared and the ladder operators as matrices in a fixed l subspace and constructs the l = 1 matrices.

topics.title: Change of basis for Lx
topics.note: Example 6.2 diagonalizes Lx for l = 1 and constructs the change-of-basis matrix.

topics.title: Angular momentum in position space
topics.note: Section 6.5 writes the angular-momentum operators in position space using the differential momentum operator.

topics.title: Spherical harmonics as eigenfunctions
topics.note: The position-space form of L squared turns the angular equation of central potentials into the angular-momentum eigenvalue equation.

topics.title: Appendices: Levi-Civita and generalized uncertainty
topics.note: Appendices 6.A and 6.B provide the Levi-Civita identities and derive the generalized uncertainty principle used for angular momentum.

topics.title: Angular-momentum uncertainty and synthesis
topics.note: For angular momentum, the covariance terms vanish in the states considered by the book, leaving uncertainty relations controlled by the commutators.
